title: Decaf Explained
summary: James Hoffmann explains how decaf coffee is made, how the decaffeination processes differ, and why decaf is roasted and stales differently. He also discusses decaf quality and health questions.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a well-researched overview of decaf processes and quality, and cite it for the claim that decaf stales faster.

quote.text: his video about decaf sold me on the idea
